hypothesis.claim: On the exact canonical opening 1000000 bytes, the byte-identical original CMIX package with only CMIX_PPM_RSS_MB=8192 added reproduces the frozen payload and archive across P, E-A, and E-B and exactly decodes enwik9_uncompressed under one singleton CPU, one canonical managed lease, fixed disk-backed roots, and a non-prize-facing identity guard.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject unless exact source/package/output identity, three fresh encode arms, exact decode, strict singleton-CPU 10GB/100GB safety receipts, canonical lease evidence, and the complete output manifest all verify.

changedMechanism: Correction-only execution envelope: remove unprovisioned runtime activation and run the opening-1M output-neutral comparison as a non-prize-facing identity phase whose elapsed and resource values are diagnostics only.
invariants: The coordinator pins itself to exactly one explicitly selected allowed CPU before preflight; guard and codec descendants inherit that singleton CPU.

Result root is exactly results/cmix_obias_source_ppm_rss_env8192_diskbacked_q0_v10, scratch root is exactly scratch/cmix_obias_source_ppm_rss_env8192_diskbacked_q0_v10, and cgroup base is exactly gamma-cmix-obias-env8192-opening1m-q0-v10 under the frozen delegated parent.
Result and scratch are distinct, disjoint, absent, and disk-backed; the cgroup base is absent before execution.
The managed exclusive lease is exactly operations/runtime/exclusive_full1g.json and its lock; no caller override exists.

The exact source.tar archive, original package, head, known payload/archive, ppmd.cpp runtime-option source, coordinator, stage, lease, verifier, stdlib guard, objective, and Python runtime closure are frozen inputs.

The guard accepts only phase identity, enforces tree RSS and cgroup memory below 10000000000 bytes, temporary disk below 100000000000 bytes, and one logical CPU, and emits elapsed diagnostics without runtime qualification.
This experiment has no Geekbench or activation input and makes memory, runtime, and PPM-trigger eligibility null/N_A, never PASS.
P is default; E-A and E-B add only CMIX_PPM_RSS_MB=8192 to the byte-identical original package.
P, E-A, and E-B must equal the exact known 172605-byte payload and 464298-byte archive; E-A decodes exactly to enwik9_uncompressed.
One outer managed lease spans all four arms; probability/state witnesses are optional corroboration and XOR witness presence is rejected.
A pass does not authorize 100M/full execution; it can only support a separately frozen 100M resource experiment, which remains blocked on exact runtime qualification.
Validation-only mode does not access cgroups, corpus bytes, the lease namespace, any active HORIZON artifact, or run a codec.
